about_the_game:
You are an alien, captured by humans during their invasion of your homeworld. Now trapped on a foreign planet, you must escape their grasp, outsmart their machines, and find your way back home.

🕹 Core Mechanics:

  • Smooth keyboard-based movement

  • Patrolling enemies and roaming security bots

  • Atmospheric nighttime levels that challenge your visibility

  • Grab and interact with objects to solve environmental puzzles

🎮 Gameplay Overview:

Step into a maze-like, puzzle-platforming adventure where every environment is a riddle waiting to be solved. Navigate through dark, hostile terrain filled with traps, barriers, and patrolling enemies—both human and robotic. Use your wits to avoid danger, collect keys, and unlock new areas as you advance through 50 increasingly challenging levels.

Outrun your captors, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the invasion—one level at a time.

✨ Features:

  • 50 handcrafted levels packed with traps, secrets, and challenges

  • Dynamic enemy AI that keeps you on your toes

  • Free unlockable skins available from the start—customize your alien your way

  • An auto-save system that tracks your progress after every level

Will you escape… or will you become another experiment?

short_description: A quirky 2D puzzle-platformer where you’re a squishy alien on the run from humans. Outsmart traps, solve puzzles, and sneak your way to freedom. Game Mechanic: - Level Progression - Puzzle Solving - Environmental Puzzle Step into a relaxing, futuristic experience on your invaded planet. (EN only)
